title: 8-bit counter with 3-state outputs

sources.document: Monolithic Memories LSI Databook, 6th ed. (1985), section 6, SN54/74LS461 8-Bit Counter

pins.name: OE
pins.text: output enable for Q0-Q7; high = high impedance; the counter keeps working

pins.name: CO
pins.text: carry out: low when Q7-Q0 are all high (and CI is low); otherwise high

pins.name: CI
pins.text: carry in: low lets INCREMENT count; high turns INCREMENT into HOLD

functions.text: Shows counter bit 0 while OE is low; high impedance while OE is high.
Shows counter bit 1 while OE is low; high impedance while OE is high.
Shows counter bit 2 while OE is low; high impedance while OE is high.
Shows counter bit 3 while OE is low; high impedance while OE is high.
Shows counter bit 4 while OE is low; high impedance while OE is high.
Shows counter bit 5 while OE is low; high impedance while OE is high.
Shows counter bit 6 while OE is low; high impedance while OE is high.
Shows counter bit 7 while OE is low; high impedance while OE is high.

functions.formula: CO = NOT(CI' AND FF0 AND FF1 AND FF2 AND FF3 AND FF4 AND FF5 AND FF6 AND FF7)
functions.text: carry out: low when Q7-Q0 are all high (and CI is low); otherwise high

rules: I1 low, I0 low: CLEAR, all bits = 0
I1 high, I0 low: LOAD, Q = D7-D0
I1 high, I0 high, CI low: INCREMENT (count up by one)
I1 high, I0 high, CI high: HOLD

electrical.notes: Commercial figures (IOL and IOH are the VOL/VOH test currents; the book gives no separate recommended IOL/IOH). Off-state current +/-100 uA. Built as a hard-wired PAL (MMI HMSI).

timing.conditions: commercial, VCC 4.75-5.25 V, TA 0-75 C, CL 50 pF, R1 200 ohm, R2 390 ohm (test load)

unknown: CO and CI: the description says CO is low when Q7-Q0 are all high, without naming CI; the switching table gives a CI-to-CO delay, so CI is taken to take part (CO low only while CI is also low). Whether I0/I1 affect CO is not stated.
Output type of CO: the description says only the data outputs (Q) are three-state; the logic diagram shows CO's buffer with no OE line. totem-pole is taken from that, not stated.
The book gives one delay per path, not split into PLH and PHL; both edges carry the same figure here.
notes: Military figures (book page 6-6): fmax 10.5 MHz, CI-CO 35/60, CK-Q 20/35, CK-CO 55/95, enable/disable 35/55 ns typ/max; setup 60 ns, clock width 40 ns low, 30 ns high. Plain file: the lookup uses it for 74LS461.
